# Distribution

<!-- shipshape-dist:managed:start -->
aggountant ships prebuilt binaries of the `aggountant` CLI through
[cargo-dist](https://axodotdev.github.io/cargo-dist/) as assets of GitHub Releases in
`aggountant/aggountant`. Nothing is published to crates.io: every crate keeps
`publish = false`, and `crates/cli/Cargo.toml` opts the CLI into cargo-dist with
`[package.metadata.dist] dist = true`.

## Generated files

- `dist-workspace.toml` is rendered from the `distributions` block of `OSS-RELEASE.md`
  by `shipshape dist generate`.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` is generated by cargo-dist from that config. Never
  edit it by hand; `dist generate` overwrites it.
- `[profile.dist]` in the root `Cargo.toml` is the build profile the workflow uses.

After changing `distributions` in `OSS-RELEASE.md`, refresh all three with
`/shipshape-dist`. No line in `dist-workspace.toml` is carried by hand.

## Platforms

Each release carries archives for macOS arm64 (`aarch64-apple-darwin`) and statically
linked Linux on arm64 and x86_64 (`aarch64-unknown-linux-musl`,
`x86_64-unknown-linux-musl`), an `aggountant-installer.sh` shell installer, and SHA-256
checksums. Intel macOS and Windows have no prebuilt binary; build from source with
`cargo install --git https://github.com/aggountant/aggountant aggountant --locked`.
Dropping one of the three triples without another install path for it is a release
gap.

## What triggers a release

Pushing a version tag (`v0.2.0`) runs `release.yml`, which builds the archives and
creates the GitHub Release. `ci.yml` is guarded to run only in
`aggountant/aggountant`, but cargo-dist's workflow has no such guard, so a version tag
pushed to any other copy of this repository that keeps `release.yml` would build a
release there too. Push version tags only to `aggountant/aggountant`.

## Before the first cut

- `.github/workflows/release.yml` exists on `main` of `aggountant/aggountant`.
- `dist-workspace.toml` still lists the three targets above.
- `dist plan` shows a single app, `aggountant`, with the three archives and the shell
  installer.
- The commit to tag is green in CI.
